sections.text:
Removes buffs from all enemies, casts “Hero King’s Authority” on all allies for 60 seconds, and increases your ATK/MATK by 30% for 60 seconds.
Added effect: Ability Power 340. Damages all enemies with magic light damage.
Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
